sanemika.p: [ saha + nemi + ka ] (ti) CL=7 It is together with (a tyred of a wheel of a chariot).

R:
sanemika：သ-နေမိက （တိ）
အကွပ်နှင့် တကွသော။

sanettika.p: [ saha + netti + ka ] (ti) CL=7 (1) It happens together with craving. (2) It has a rope (that is craving).

R:
sanettika：သ-နေတ္တိက （တိ）
တဏှာနှင့် တကွသော။
